study_design: Case-control study of newly diagnosed, histologically confirmed prostate cancer
reason: The abstract evaluates newly diagnosed incident prostate cancer but does not report an aggressive, high-grade, advanced, metastatic, or lethal incident endpoint. Analytic sample sizes differ by biomarker and are not stated in the abstract, so no single article-level analytic N or case count is assigned.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: Multivariable-adjusted models showed a positive linear relationship between PCa and serum calcium (OR, 1.12; CI, 1.00-1.25 per 0.1 nmol/L).
estimate_classifications.reason: This estimate concerns overall newly diagnosed prostate cancer, with no aggressive disease restriction.
